en.title: This 5 cm Shrimp Flips Over Starfish! What Is It?
en.description: The harlequin shrimp feeds almost only on starfish, flipping a slow sea star onto its back to eat its soft tissue. It grows to just 5 cm and hunts in pairs on Indo-Pacific reefs.
